summary: Sega Technical Institute's mask-swapping Genesis platformer, later rereleased through Sega Classics and Nintendo's Genesis app.

entries.title: Kid Chameleon
entries.definitive_edition: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for modern save/rewind convenience; owned Sega Classics remains a good PC capture fallback.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with official emulator features.

primary.version: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release
primary.why: Kid Chameleon is available through Nintendo Classics/Switch Online, with modern save/rewind/online-share features and Switch 2 compatibility support; this is the current official route for the Genesis game.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online app with an Expansion Pack membership. Use an owned PC Sega Classics copy or original Genesis cartridge only for alternate access.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is official emulation of the Genesis release, not a remaster.
